clause_text: The Act mandates the Khadi and Village Industries Commission,  as a statutory body under the Government of India, to plan, promote, facilitate, organize  and assist in the development of khadi and village industries including measures relating  to training, raw materials, marketing, research, quality, etc. and other matters connected  therewith or incidental thereto, in accordance with the provisions of the Act. 1.2.4 Definition of Micro, Small and Medium enterprises: To help MSME scale operations and access better resources, the investment and turnover  limits for classification have been increased by 2.5 times and 2 times, respectively.

The revised classification criteria are as follows:-   a micro enterprise, where the investment in plant and machinery or equipment does  not exceed 2.5 crore and turnover does not exceed 10 crore;   a small enterprise, where the investment in plant and machinery or equipment does  not exceed 25 crore and turnover does not exceed 100 crore; and   a medium enterprise, where the investment in plant and machinery or equipment  does not exceed 125 crore and turnover does not exceed 500 crore.
